# Android sign-in and imported conversation release

Status: production deployment and server readback passed; physical-device acceptance pending.

## Scope and authorization

- Feature PR: #3084. Selective release train: #3087.
- The owner authorized this production release and a single protected-ref exception limited to this fix if normal merging is blocked. Repository protection settings must remain unchanged.
- Google Play submission remains held until physical-device acceptance of browser sign-in, original imported title and transcript reopening.
- Server scope is exact native-authenticated GET `/api/conversations/{id}/continuation`. Existing owner checks, conversation/source locks and token validation remain in force. Other methods and the review continuation action are not newly enrolled.
- Native scope is source-title display/search/accessibility, display time-zone headers, and one fresh-state/fresh-S256-PKCE retry following an HTTPS Auth Tab verification failure or timeout. Cancellation and a second failure reject without credentials.
